cases.title: July 2026 financing stress versus prior survival intent

packet_A.known_then: Public 2024 survival/timing risk intent and latest publicly filed March 2026 securities report. Actual late-July financing and positions were not public in this corpus.
packet_A.valuation_or_price: No authenticated July trading/financing packet or point-in-time entry valuation
packet_A.disconfirmers_kind: Generic analyst risk checks, not known July events or verified SALP pre-event analysis
disconfirmers: Potential correlated long and short-side moves
packet_A.exclusion_rule: June 30 holdings were not published until August 14; they may support later reconstruction, never public foreknowledge at July cutoff.

packet_B.actual_action_interval: Letter says Wednesday night/Thursday morning; mapped to July 29–30, 2026 from publication week, not an independently time-stamped trade ledger
packet_B.risk_statement_timing: L03 T0 broad risk intent, June 4, 2024
packet_B.outcome_communication_timing: L07 T2, published July 31, 2026; exact issuance/time unknown
packet_B.june_holdings_role: L16 dated retrospective regulatory observation, released after event
packet_B.attribution: Letter presented as Aschenbrenner signed communication; original authentication not obtained. Citadel counterparty is contemporaneous journalist reporting, not the reproduced letter’s own named counterparty.

packet_C.endpoint: Interim state in letter published 2026-07-31; no audited final month-end endpoint
packet_C.metric: Manager-reported unaudited net MTD loss −67%; net YTD +80%
packet_C.benchmark: None used; no alpha or comparative performance claim
packet_C.maximum_drawdown: Not established; MTD loss is not necessarily peak-to-trough drawdown
packet_C.continued_status: Letter says hybrid fund continued; does not verify present operations.

packet_D.assessment: Apparent tension between prior survival intent and reported financing vulnerability; subsequent risk redesign is dated corrective action.
not_established: That the AGI thesis was false
That the fund was permanently bankrupt or fully liquidated
That funded long options remove option-price loss or all portfolio risk
rival_explanations: Model and process failures not documented
Changing holdings and offsets absent from 13F
packet_D.research_lesson: A long-horizon thesis needs financing, liquidation and liquidity resilience; technical insight alone does not establish an investable risk structure.
packet_D.invalidates_lesson: Independent primary evidence contradicts the reproduced financing account
packet_D.next_decision: Require financing/option terms and audited outcomes before reconstructing exact causal P&L or copying the risk structure.
